integrity: The proof reduces independent sets to totally isotropic subspaces in the symplectic central quotient, proves the sharp counting bound, constructs a Desarguesian symplectic spread for the chromatic upper bound, and classifies equality in both steps. A standalone checker verifies the exact values and spread partitions in the five-dimensional cases over F_2 and F_3.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to Heisenberg Lie algebras, whose commutator is controlled by one nondegenerate alternating form.
The clique number is not determined.
The general projective chromatic-number/abelian-cover equivalence is prior work; the new contribution is the exact Heisenberg value and the extremal classification.
title: Heisenberg noncommuting graphs have exact spread colorings
